Name: Janas face scars plus bonus
Author: janamods01
Description:
Scars are cool and we should all love them (in ourselves and others), so I've come up with a few marks to give your farmer some personality!

Features ten scar designs (from minimal to huge) plus a few bonus designs just because I had space to squeeze them in:

- full black eyes 
- ghoul eyes, tokyo ghoul style
- eyebags for the farmers who pass out at 2 every day
- BNHA Izuku's crisscross pink lines from OfA
- princess Mononoke's red markings
- ATLA air nomads' blue head arrow (because the first scar is totally Zuko inspired)

Hope you enjoy!

P.S.: Because of the way accessories work (with necessarily mirrored side views), scars supposed to be on just one side will appear on both side views. I'm very green at modding, so if anyone knows a way to fix that I'm all ears!
